We are looking for a highly motivated professional to join our Fund Finance and Treasury Operations team. You will collaborate with global stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial information, drive operational excellence, and support strategic business decisions.

Treasury & Credit Facility Management

Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager – India Lead, CTF & BSRA

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what #LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager to join our Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) team within Finance. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

• Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.

• Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.

• Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.

• NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.

• Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.

• Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.

• Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.

• Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.

• Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

• Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.

• Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.

• Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.

• Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.

• Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.

• People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

A. Preparation of financial statements

2. Review the inputs into the monthly reporting tool and ensure smooth closure of monthly reporting.

3. To prepare financial statements as per IND AS for regulatory reporting.

4. To maintain chart of accounts as per the headquarters guidelines

B. Regulatory Compliance:

1. To prepare various regulatory statutory returns on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and on annual basis and submit the same with the regulator on a timely manner.

2. To ensure that the other regulatory certification and declaration such as FDI Certificate, Statutory Auditor’s Certificate are filed with the regulator’s on a timely basis.

3. To support in preparation of data for RBI related queries and Information sought from accounting.

4. To support the Regulator’s inspection from accounting and reporting standpoint.

7. To prepare and facilitate various regulatory reports for ALCO meetings.

8. To ensure all the relevant and applicable compliances are complied with and closed on a timely manner in the Compliance tool.

1. To prepare the required balance sheet & P&L schedules as required during the Statutory audit.

2. To work closely with auditors and ensure that the financials contain all relevant disclosures applicable to the Company.

3. To review the audit observations and Management Letter and take it to the relevant team for response and closure.

4. To monitor and ensure the Internal Control Systems are in place as per the Mercedes- Benz Guidelines.

5. To ensure that the Internal Control on Financial Reporting are in place by demonstrating and documenting the controls in place.

6. To prepare presentations for various meetings related to audits like audit committee and board.

3. To review and approve the daily clearing entries.

7. To recommend for accounting approvals from CAO in special cases related to accounting.

8. To prepare wholesale system reconciliation.

9. To prepare workings and raise the invoices to intercompany for various transactions.

10. Reconciliation of TDS related to dealers.

11. To prepare the dealer balances confirmation and ensure that the same is received on time in coordination with wholesale team.

2. To review the performance of SSC and validate the head count justification.

3. To train and educate the SSC to comply with both the IFRS and Ind AS Accounting Standards.

4. To liaison with Treasury Centre of India (TCI) for various day to day and operation topics.

5. To provide various accounting and financial related inputs to TCI for getting the Credit Rating letters.

6. To work closely with TCI in monitoring the cash flow position of the Company and facilitate them with the latest ALM and LCR submission to take meaning decisions.

7. To support other functions of the Company as and when the demand arises.

F. To automate the various manual process to ensure accuracy and increase efficiency.

2. Review the inputs into the monthly reporting tool and ensure smooth closure of monthly reporting.

• Partner with business and technology teams to identify systems and tools required to support organizational scale.

• Support the development of a scalable shared-services operating model across Finance and other corporate support functions.

• Evaluate investments in enterprise systems, infrastructure, benefits and other corporate programs from a financial and business perspective.
• Establish appropriate service metrics, controls and cost-efficiency measures.

• Prepare high-quality financial and business-performance presentations for senior leadership and the Board.

Role Overview:

The Non-Financial Risk (NFR) team supports the Mizuho U.S. Operations (MUSO) risk management framework through risk governance, analytics, controls, reporting and execution. Mizuho Pune is being developed as an integrated extension of the global NFR and wider Risk organization, providing scalable, follow-the-sun risk management capabilities across MUSO’s Corporate & Investment Bank (CIB).

The NFR Analyst / Associate will be part of the Pune NFR capability and will support the NFR India Lead in delivering high-quality risk governance, reporting, analytics, review and challenge, issue tracking, and stakeholder support. The role is suited for a developing risk professional who can work with data, processes and stakeholders to identify risk themes, improve transparency, and support timely escalation and remediation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the build-out and ongoing operation of the NFR capability in Mizuho Pune, working closely with the NFR India Lead and global NFR stakeholders.
• Assist with first-level review of key NFR information, including risk appetite metrics, risk events, RCSA outputs, KRIs, control indicators and management information.
• Analyze risk data to identify trends, anomalies, recurring issues and areas that may require management attention or further review.
• Support RCSA transformation, quality assurance activities and review of areas where risks may be under-assessed or where control outcomes indicate emerging concerns.
• Prepare, maintain and enhance recurring NFR reporting, dashboards, governance materials and management information to support risk oversight and decision-making.
• Track actions, issues, escalations and remediation plans to support timely closure and effective management visibility.
• Partner with teams across MUSO Risk, Business, Operations and Technology to gather inputs, validate information, challenge data and follow up on open items.
• Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring reporting, control and governance processes.
• Support the controlled use of analytics, automation and AI-enabled approaches to improve risk identification, reporting quality and process efficiency, ensuring outputs remain explainable and auditable.
• Contribute to a strong risk culture within the Pune NFR team by demonstrating ownership, attention to detail and constructive challenge.

Experience & Skills:

Required:

• 5–12 years of experience in Non-Financial Risk, Operational Risk, Controls, Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Reporting or a related risk management function within a financial institution.
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related discipline.
• Good understanding of RCSA, risk events, KRIs, risk appetite, controls, issues management and operational risk governance.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess risk data, identify patterns and translate findings into clear and actionable commentary.
• Experience preparing management information, dashboards, governance packs or risk reporting materials.
• Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset and ability to manage recurring deliverables accurately and on time.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to present risk information clearly and work effectively across regions and functions.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with workflow, reporting or analytics tools is beneficial.

Preferred:

• Experience supporting CIB, Markets, Banking or Treasury businesses.
• Exposure to global or follow-the-sun operating models, including India-based risk or controls teams.
• Experience with RCSA transformation, controls testing, risk analytics, reporting automation or process improvement initiatives.
• Familiarity with data visualization, automation or AI-enabled risk reporting tools.

Success in the Role:

Success will be measured by the ability to provide reliable analytical and execution support to the Pune NFR capability, deliver accurate and timely risk reporting, contribute to effective review and challenge, maintain strong tracking of issues and actions, and help simplify, standardize and automate recurring NFR processes. The individual should operate as a trusted member of the NFR India team and help strengthen connectivity between Pune, MUSO Risk and global NFR stakeholders.
